opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 individuals with diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation; groups should not be formed entirely of academic institution members.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing up to £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups that bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups to focus on data analysis and synthesis.

opportunities.title: Long-term Research Grants

amount.raw: Funding up to £500 per year for a decade of data collection; claim first five years' funding (£3,500) in year 1, and an additional £3,500 in year 6.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners, reserve managers and consultants as well as university academics; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides a small amount of funding each year for 10 years to enable existing short-term projects with at least 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term, establishing a new portfolio of long-term experiments/datasets relevant to today's issues.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level; awarded to individuals, not organisations; projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Improving the education of future generations of ecologists by providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning and research informing teaching and learning practices within ecology.

opportunities.title: Connecting Ecologists with Other Disciplines Grants

amount.raw: Grant awards of up to £20,000 can be claimed from the applicant.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible; placements up to 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements in different disciplines and sectors, immersing an ecologist in another professional world where ecology can make a difference.

opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; funding for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world; not a scholarship and cannot be used towards completing an undergraduate or master's degree.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; awards open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; projects max 12 months; no restrictions on where applicants come from or carry out work.
opportunities.summary: Providing funding of up to £2,000 for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 is available for virtual conferences/courses; a maximum of £500 is available for events in person.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (postdocs, undergraduates and masters students not eligible); work or study at a university or research institution; must give a presentation if attending a meeting.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and to network and publicise their research by presenting at workshops and conferences. Next application window is 24 August - 8 September 2026.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; at least three years since last BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026 in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation-related costs. Open call 17 July - 8 September 2026.
